_metadata.description: Provider role, profile, and policy discovery.

requirements.title: AI Gateway presents resource-owned role catalogs without becoming catalog authority
requirements.description: The gateway must read role, policy, model, and constraint data from resource command surfaces and clearly indicate that resources remain the source of truth for concrete model selection.

validation.notes: Validates parsing and normalization for Ollama and OpenRouter policy command output.
Validates the inventory RPC returns normalized resource inventory.

requirements.title: Role health includes smoke-test status and policy drift evidence
requirements.description: Operators must see whether each provider role resolves, whether representative calls work, and whether documentation/policy data appears stale or inconsistent.

validation.notes: Validates role smoke-test result capture without requiring a live provider in unit suites.
